issue.title: Web: retry failed administrator loading without changing the payer-transfer organisation
issue.titleHTML: Web: retry failed administrator loading without changing the payer-transfer organisation
issue.body:
## What happens

In **Change who pays**, choosing an organisation loads its members so the user can select the other payer's administrator. If that request fails, the form says:

> The transfer service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

However, the administrator selector contains only its placeholder, **Review payer transfer** is disabled, and there is no retry action. The selected organisation remains unchanged. Users must discover that clearing and reselecting it starts another request, or reload the page.

## Reproduction

Verified on main `07f32e5cbdc758ddebfbc8a431302b93d2daa98a`, macOS arm64, Node 24.15.0, Vitest 5.0.0 / happy-dom, using a temporary component probe in a clean checkout:

1. Render the real `PersonalTransferStart` with synthetic available capabilities, a signed-in account and an organisation `org-b`.
2. Make the first `fetchMembers("org-b")` reject with `Error("server error (503)")`; configure the next call to return one owner.
3. Choose `org-b`. Observe the error, the empty administrator selector, the disabled review button and the absence of a retry control. The members API has been called once.
4. Choose the blank organisation option and then `org-b` again. The owner loads; selecting them enables **Review payer transfer**.

The probe passed against unchanged production code and was removed after verification. It made no quote, transfer or payment request. All APIs were mocked; no live account or native browser journey was exercised.

## Expected behaviour

After administrator discovery fails, users can explicitly retry for the currently selected organisation without changing that selection or reloading the page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A failed members request exposes a clearly labelled retry control for the selected organisation, alongside the existing accessible error.
- [ ] Retry preserves the selected organisation, clears the previous discovery error while loading and prevents overlapping retry requests. It does not fetch a quote or create a transfer.
- [ ] A successful retry repopulates eligible administrator choices and removes the recovery control/error. Selecting an administrator enables the existing review flow.
- [ ] A second failure restores the retry control. A successful empty result is not presented as a request failure.
- [ ] Changing or clearing the organisation clears recovery state associated with the old selection. Keep member-discovery errors distinct from quote/submission errors so those failures do not offer the wrong retry action.
- [ ] Add component tests for initial failure, pending retry, repeated failure and recovery using deferred promises and synthetic fixtures; pass the web test suite.

## Starting points

- [`PersonalTransferStart` in PayerTransferStart.tsx](https://github.com/getsotto/sotto/blob/07f32e5cbdc758ddebfbc8a431302b93d2daa98a/web/src/PayerTransferStart.tsx): `chooseOrganisation`, `members`, the shared error state and the rendered controls.
- [`PayerTransferJourneys.test.tsx`](https://github.com/getsotto/sotto/blob/07f32e5cbdc758ddebfbc8a431302b93d2daa98a/web/src/__tests__/PayerTransferJourneys.test.tsx): existing API mocks and organisation/member fixtures.

Keep this scoped to administrator discovery in the personal transfer-start form. No transfer authority, billing rules, server API or sponsored-transfer changes are needed. Open/closed issues and open PRs were checked for overlap; #635 covers inbox pagination, not this form.

Suitable for a first contribution using the existing React state and test patterns. Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`, including DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
